title: Rimu Zhi Xi
synopsis:
The film focuses on the evolution and changes of human being’s life in the first-person perspective of animals. Each cat in the video keeps alive its own instinct and characteristics, and lives a healthy and happy life owing to the care and love of Gina. In the irreversible end of Gina’s life, their hearts beat as one with the heartbeat of Gina and guard Gina by her side ever after in their own way.

(Source: Official Vimeo Channel)
